name: Crimson Animatronic
source: In this Visual Novel, a Mascot Horror parody, you control Nyan, a were-cat radio host who must survive a deeply disturbing cannibal family and Charkelene Chan, a massive, vengeful red maned wolf animatronic. Choose your path and stare down enemies to escape and unlock 5 crazy endings!
translation: In this Visual Novel, a Mascot Horror parody, you control Nyan, a were-cat radio host who must survive a deeply disturbing cannibal family and Charkelene Chan, a massive, vengeful red maned wolf animatronic. Choose your path and stare down enemies to escape and unlock 5 crazy endings!
